purpose: Train and serve the original random-initialized 124M student on natural conversation and real offline tools.
selection: Initial combined endpoint is fixed before development. Retain negative results. Use distinct evaluation cases for any later promotion.
confirmation: Keep the original sealed 100 cases unscored until development passes. Show raw student outputs and actual broker traces.
separate_product_modes: structured: learned route and slot ranking; GPT-2 numeric and prose replies
product: same route and broker, explicitly rendered observed numbers and errors, v1 span reader or GPT-2 for remaining text
secondary_selection: Comparisons use the identical original A rubric and endpoint. A may guide iteration. B remains unopened for a single preselected follow-on. The original sealed set remains reserved for release.

followon_if_initial_screen_fails.hypothesis: Test genuinely new conversational forms, real short human dialogue and rewrite/extraction data, plus isolated post-tool supervision and more varied tool phrasing.
